column1: # ort-webgpu parity summary vs exported upstream goldens — per model x size
# engine ort-webgpu; EP lib onnxruntime-ep-webgpu 0.4.0; i265 RTX 4080 (Vulkan), ORT 1.31
# gate: |got-want| <= 1e-3 JND on first eval + bit-identical repeat (the test asserts both)
# rows: ladder pairs contributing to the cell; worst_* = max |got-want| / JND over those rows
#   (JND empty for *_ref columns — reference-side scores have no JND scale)
# status: PASS = all rows within gate; OOM = VK_ERROR_OUT_OF_DEVICE_MEMORY (smaller sizes pass);
#         LOADFAIL = CPU-assigned host ops, session refuses to commit (CPU fallback forbidden)
